mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM `book_time_interval` a LEFT JOIN `conference` b ON b.`id` = a.`conference_id` where b.`status` = 0 and b.`id` = #{conferenceId}
select count(`id`) num, `time_interval` periodTime from `book_interval_record` group by `time_interval`

SELECT count(a.`time_interval`) num, b.`name` AS `name`, b.`id` AS `conferenceId` FROM `book_time_interval` a LEFT JOIN `conference` b ON a.`conference_id` = b.`id` WHERE b.`name` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.id, b.`name`

SELECT count(distinct a.`time_interval`) num, b.`name` as `name`, b.`id` AS `conferenceId` FROM `book_interval_record` a LEFT JOIN `conference` b ON a.`conference_id` = b.`id` where
a.`appointment_date` between to_timestamp(#{st}, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_timestamp(#{et}, 'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
a.`appointment_date` between #{st} and #{et}
GROUP BY b.id

SELECT a.`conference_id` `conferenceId`, b.`book_id` `bookId`, a.`time_interval` `timeInterval`, CASE WHEN c.`status` = 'RESERVED' THEN c.`status` WHEN c.`status` = 'APPROVAL' THEN c.`status` ELSE a.`book_status` END AS `bookStatus`, c.`conference_theme` `conferenceTheme`, c.`subscribe_person` `subscribePerson`, c.`book_num` `bookNum`, d.`name` `conferenceType` FROM book_time_interval a LEFT JOIN `book_interval_record` b ON a.`time_interval` = b.`time_interval` AND b.`appointment_date` = #{date} and b.`conference_id` = #{conferenceId} LEFT JOIN `book_room` c ON b.`book_id` = c.`id` and c.`conference_id` = #{conferenceId} LEFT JOIN `conference_type` d ON c.`conference_type` = d.`id` WHERE a.`conference_id` = #{conferenceId} AND c.`status` != 'CANCEL_RESERVATION' ORDER BY `bookStatus` ASC, a.`time_interval` ASC
